jobs.title: PROJECT - Analytics and Insights Engineer III - Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As an Analytics and Insights Engineer III on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for...

Designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines, curated data sets, and analytics solutions that support client reporting and mission needs
Developing and enhancing analytics, search, and data discovery capabilities using Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), and platform tools
Analyzing structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, generate insights, and support investigative use cases
Collaborating with client stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into scalable data and analytics solutions
Performing testing, documentation, deployment support, and data quality activities to maintain reliable outputs and continuous improvement

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree
5+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting data, analytics, or business intelligence solutions
4+ years of experience with Python
3+ years of experience using Structured Query Language (SQL)
Active Top Secret clearance with completed adjudication and ability to obtain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI)
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

1+ year of experience with R programming language
1+ year of experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch
1+ year of experience in an investigator role

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Washington DC, Deloitte is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Washington DC and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $113,000 to $188,400.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: SEM Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Additionally, You Will Enjoy

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
401(k) with company match
Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career

Job Description

We are looking for a talented individual…

To join our team! CLEAResult's Strategic Energy Management (SEM) team is expanding, and we have a new opportunity for a Data Analyst to help power the work of our SEM experts across the US and Canada. If you love digging into data, spotting patterns others miss, and building the tools and templates that make a whole program run smoother, this is a great place to make an impact.

As a Data Analyst, you'll be the engine behind the scenes for our Statistical Analysts and SEM program teams across North America, supporting energy modeling, standardizing processes, and keeping our data clean, consistent, and ready to drive real decisions. This role is primarily internally facing and centered on data analysis, with occasional interaction with clients and end-use customers to gather data or answer questions. You'll play a central role in bringing consistency and efficiency to how our SEM teams work internationally, directly supporting the accuracy and quality of the models and reports our program depends on.

Here at CLEAResult, you will fit right in with our energetic team if you are resourceful, resilient, and kind.

In this role, you will…

Perform pre- and post-modeling data review and manipulation to support our Statistical Analysts.
Manipulate and format production data with precision and consistency.
Analyze large data sets to catch errors and ensure accuracy before it moves downstream.
Integrate data into statistical software templates.
Collaborate with internal and external teams to build and maintain database files.
Partner with program teams across the organization to create and maintain standardized templates for energy modeling and program data.
Write clear work instructions for newly developed templates, so others can pick them up with ease.
Track, draft, edit, and quality-control final models and reports.
Help automate data processing to save time and reduce manual error.
Troubleshoot, modify, and build tools using Visual Basic and Excel formulas.
Manage and manipulate data in Smartsheet.
Support benchmarking reporting and contribute to the development of our digital infrastructure.

For this exciting career opportunity, you're a great fit if you have…

Strong data manipulation and formatting skills, with an eye for consistency and detail
Experience analyzing large, complex data sets
Comfort working with statistical software and templates
Proficiency in Visual Basic and advanced Excel formulas
Experience with Smartsheet
SharePoint experience
A collaborative mindset, comfortable working across internal teams and occasionally with external clients and customers
Energy industry experience preferred, but not required

Please note: sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

Note To Candidates

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every single one of the qualifications as described in a job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive organization and we are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of the qualifications as described.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, MFN RCX
jobs.description:
Description

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities

Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of program or project management experience
2+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Experience writing SQL queries to extract and analyze data, track program health, and drive decisions
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon experience in an analytical or program management capacity

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams
Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Financial & Data Analyst (FinOps) - Hanover, Maryland
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

Senior Financial & Data Analyst (FinOps) roles at Ciena sit at the intersection of technology, finance, and data-driven decision-making. This position plays a pivotal role in running Information Technology (IT) like a business—bringing transparency, predictability, and accountability to IT and cloud investments. With direct exposure to senior leaders across IT, Finance, and Cloud teams, this role offers the opportunity to influence strategy, optimize spend at scale, and help Ciena continue to lead with both innovation and humanity.

How You Will Make An Impact

Establish financial transparency across run, grow, and transform IT spend through accurate forecasting, variance analysis, and standardized key performance indicators (KPIs)
Drive measurable cost optimization and value realization across applications, infrastructure, vendors, and cloud consumption
Own IT contract and renewal financial governance, enabling data-driven decisions to renew, renegotiate, optimize, or exit agreements
Partner with Finance Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and Accounting to ensure strong accruals, capitalization practices, and audit readiness
Design executive-ready dashboards and analytics that serve as a single source of truth for IT and cloud financial performance
Advance Cloud Financial Operations (FinOps) accountability through tagging discipline, consumption insights, and commitment management
Improve financial and operational processes through standardization, automation, and KPI-driven maturity tracking

The Must Haves

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
5+ years of experience in financial analytics, data analytics, or Financial Operations (FinOps) roles
Strong foundation in accounting principles, financial analysis, and variance management
Advanced experience working with large datasets using tools such as Excel, Structured Query Language (SQL), Power BI, or similar
Proven ability to translate complex metrics into clear insights for senior and executive stakeholders
Experience supporting Information Technology (IT) or technology-focused organizations
Hands-on cloud cost management or FinOps experience across providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

Nice To Haves

Experience managing IT vendor contracts, renewals, and financial negotiations
Exposure to automation or data integration initiatives that reduce manual financial effort
Familiarity with cloud tagging strategies and chargeback or showback models
Experience building KPI frameworks to track process efficiency and operational maturity
Knowledge of enterprise financial systems or IT service management platforms

Pay Range

The annual pay range for this position, in the United States of America, is $89,300.00 - $142,700.00 USD..

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Propelled Brands Franchising, LLC

Propelled Brands® is the multi-brand platform company under which service industry franchise brands operate and grow. We are excited to propel brands forward. We know franchising, we love franchisees, and we have a supportive, motivating culture. Our current brands are FASTSIGNS®, My Salon Suite®, and Camp Bow Wow®.

What We Offer

At Propelled Brands, our total rewards package is a direct reflection of our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent. Our benefits are built on the foundation of our core values: Make it Happen, Expertise and Mastery, Positive Attitude, Growth Mindset, and being Considerate. As a member of our team, you will find a supportive environment with rewards designed to help you thrive.

Employer sponsored medical and dental plans
Voluntary benefits such as vision, critical illness, accident, and pet insurance
100% Employer sponsored Short-Term Disability, Long-term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance
Retirement Savings employer match up to 3% and 100% vested
Generous paid time off policies
Paid Parental Leave for mothers and fathers

About The Opportunity

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support design and construction projects across the Propelled Brands portfolio. In this role, you will manage project files, budgets, schedules, and documentation while helping Project Managers and Construction Managers keep projects organized and moving forward.

You will serve as a key point of coordination among internal teams, franchisees, General Contractors, designers, architects, and vendors. This role also supports team meetings, vendor agreements, invoice processing, project closeout, and annual Franchise Disclosure Document updates.

This is a full-time, salaried, non-exempt position based in our Carrollton, Texas office. The Project Coordinator reports directly to the Vice President of Design & Construction.

The Ideal Candidate

You are proactive, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment. You communicate clearly, pay close attention to details, and understand the importance of keeping project information accurate, current, and accessible.

You enjoy coordinating across teams and take ownership of schedules, documentation, and follow-through. You also bring a practical, solutions-focused mindset and can anticipate needs before they become roadblocks.

Essential Functions

Project Coordination & Communication: Serve as the primary liaison among Project Managers, Construction Managers, General Contractors, designers, and architects. Coordinate with franchisees as needed and maintain a timely flow of information so stakeholders remain aligned on project status and requirements.
Meeting Coordination: Schedule and coordinate brand team meetings, prepare agendas, document meeting minutes, and track follow-up items.
Project Controls: Assist Project Managers and Construction Managers with budget tracking, cost coding, and project schedule management.
Project Documentation: Prepare, manage, and distribute contracts, submittals, Requests for Information (RFIs), change orders, purchase orders, and other project-related documentation.
File Management: Organize and maintain complete, accurate, and current electronic project files across all brands.
Vendor Support: Assist the Vendor Manager with pipeline calls, schedule management, and material sample coordination.
Invoice Processing: Accurately process vendor invoices and monthly pay applications through the accounting software.
Agreement Management: Maintain an up-to-date file of NDAs and master contracts for vendors, architects, and General Contractors.
Project Closeout: Support the project closeout process by compiling warranties, as-built drawings, operations manuals, and other required closeout documentation.
Compliance Support: Assist with the preparation and coordination of annual Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD) updates.

What We Need

Education and Experience

Associate or bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
Relevant experience in a construction project coordination or administrative role may be considered in place of a degree
One to three years of experience in a project coordination or administrative role within the construction industry
Basic ability to read and understand construction drawings

Skills And Qualifications

Proficiency in Smartsheet and Google Workspace
Proficiency with AVID accounting software
Familiarity with Gemini AI
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
Proactive, problem-solving mindset

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have any supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

This role operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment, including computers, smartphones, video conferencing and webinar tools, phones, photocopiers, printers, filing cabinets, shredders, and fax machines.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to walk, talk, see, and hear. The Team Member must also be able to lift up to 20 pounds.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, salaried, non-exempt position requiring at least 40 hours per week. The regular schedule is Monday through Friday, between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel

Travel is expected to be less than 10%. Out-of-area and overnight travel may be required based on individual job responsibilities. Some travel may occur on weekends or internationally. Company events, including Summits and the Annual Convention, may also require travel.

We believe that everyone is capable of great things. Because of this, we encourage you to apply even if you do not have 100% of the qualifications listed above.

EEO Statement

Propelled Brands values diversity and inclusion because it brings richness and strength to our business. We envision diversity as encompassing an individual’s unique characteristics and experiences, including not only race, gender, ethnicity, age, religion, disability, national origin, and sexual orientation, but also personality, gender expression, military status, mental health, educational and career backgrounds, and other life experiences. We know that supporting and building diversity is the right thing to do for our employees, our franchisees, our franchisees’ teams, and our stakeholders.

70,000 - 85,000 USD per year(Denver, CO)

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Data Protection
jobs.description:
The Legal team is responsible for managing the legal affairs of the company, including providing legal counsel across the organization, handling disputes, and creating and enforcing intellectual property.

Position Summary

The Privacy COE is seeking a Program Coordinator, Data Protection to execute high-priority privacy and healthcare compliance workstreams, with emphasis on cybersecurity/privacy breach response and HIPAA program implementation for newly acquired entities.

This delivery-oriented role serves as project manager, coordinator, and execution lead. It is not an advisory legal role; legal and regulatory interpretation questions will be escalated while this position owns workflow execution, tracking, documentation, and follow-through.

Location and Work Hours

This position will be based in the United States because the work and contacts for daily work will be concentrated primarily in the United States, including U.S. cybersecurity breach response and HIPAA program activities, and will mainly support the Head of Privacy, who is located in the East Coast of the United States. Candidates outside the United States will be considered if they can maintain permanent U.S.-based working hours.

Role Objective

Increase capacity and throughput in Resmed’s highest-risk privacy workstreams by managing timelines, dependencies, documentation, and stakeholder coordination, enabling senior privacy leadership to focus on activities with high business value, direct support of important stakeholders, strategic advisory work and complex legal support.

Key Responsibilities

Privacy and Cybersecurity Incident Response

Manage operational workflows for cybersecurity and privacy incidents involving personal information, protected health information, or other regulated data.
Coordinate intake, triage support, evidence collection, stakeholder follow-up, remediation tracking, status reporting, and closure documentation.
Maintain incident trackers, timelines, decision logs, playbooks, templates, checklists, and escalation paths.
Identify delays, missing inputs, bottlenecks, and process gaps that may affect incident response timelines or documentation quality.
Support after event lessons learned and areas of improvement.

HIPAA Program Implementation for Acquisitions

Support HIPAA program buildout for newly acquired entities, including rollout of policies, procedures, templates, training, and related documentation.
Track milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, open items, completion evidence, and readiness activities for audits, assessments, training, and governance.
Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Security, IT, HR, and business stakeholders to complete onboarding and integration activities.

Project Management and Privacy Operations

Create and maintain project plans, action trackers, dashboards, issue logs, SOPs, and repeatable workflows for assigned privacy initiatives.
Drive workstream meetings, prepare agendas, document decisions and action items, and follow up to closure.
Support reporting on operational metrics, completion rates, aging items, risks, and status summaries.
Recommend process improvements to reduce cycle time, improve handoffs, eliminate duplication, and strengthen documentation.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
Organization, documentation, communication, stakeholder coordination, and follow-through skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities with urgency, accuracy, discretion, and sound judgment.
Proficiency with collaboration, reporting, and productivity tools.
Strong intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and willingness to quickly build fluency in privacy, cybersecurity, HIPAA, and compliance concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

High proficiency using AI tools to improve productivity, automate repeatable workflows, summarize and organize complex information, generate first drafts of project documentation, and identify opportunities to accelerate privacy operations while maintaining appropriate confidentiality, accuracy, and human oversight.

Success Profile

Highly organized, structured, execution-focused, and able to create order from ambiguity.
Persistent and diplomatic in follow-up, with strong ownership and attention to detail.
Comfortable working cross-functionally on sensitive matters involving legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, and reputational risk.
Uses good judgment to act independently where appropriate and escalate when legal interpretation, risk acceptance, or senior leadership decision-making is required.

Measures of Success

Incident response and HIPAA integration workstreams are tracked accurately, completed on time, and supported by clear documentation.

Developing and enhancing analytics, search, and data discovery capabilities using Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), and platform tools
Analyzing structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, generate insights, and support investigative use cases
Collaborating with client stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into scalable data and analytics solutions
Performing testing, documentation, deployment support, and data quality activities to maintain reliable outputs and continuous improvement

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

Ability to lead projects or workstreams

Ability to meet deadlines

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. 5+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting data, analytics, or business intelligence solutions

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
About Propelled Brands Franchising, LLC

Propelled Brands® is the multi-brand platform company under which service industry franchise brands operate and grow. We are excited to propel brands forward. We know franchising, we love franchisees, and we have a supportive, motivating culture. Our current brands are FASTSIGNS®, My Salon Suite®, and Camp Bow Wow®.

What We Offer

At Propelled Brands, our total rewards package is a direct reflection of our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent. Our benefits are built on the foundation of our core values: Make it Happen, Expertise and Mastery, Positive Attitude, Growth Mindset, and being Considerate. As a member of our team, you will find a supportive environment with rewards designed to help you thrive.

Employer sponsored medical and dental plans
Voluntary benefits such as vision, critical illness, accident, and pet insurance
100% Employer sponsored Short-Term Disability, Long-term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance
Retirement Savings employer match up to 3% and 100% vested
Generous paid time off policies
Paid Parental Leave for mothers and fathers

About The Opportunity

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support design and construction projects across the Propelled Brands portfolio. In this role, you will manage project files, budgets, schedules, and documentation while helping Project Managers and Construction Managers keep projects organized and moving forward.

You will serve as a key point of coordination among internal teams, franchisees, General Contractors, designers, architects, and vendors. This role also supports team meetings, vendor agreements, invoice processing, project closeout, and annual Franchise Disclosure Document updates.

This is a full-time, salaried, non-exempt position based in our Carrollton, Texas office. The Project Coordinator reports directly to the Vice President of Design & Construction.

The Ideal Candidate

You are proactive, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment. You communicate clearly, pay close attention to details, and understand the importance of keeping project information accurate, current, and accessible.

You enjoy coordinating across teams and take ownership of schedules, documentation, and follow-through. You also bring a practical, solutions-focused mindset and can anticipate needs before they become roadblocks.

Essential Functions

Project Coordination & Communication: Serve as the primary liaison among Project Managers, Construction Managers, General Contractors, designers, and architects. Coordinate with franchisees as needed and maintain a timely flow of information so stakeholders remain aligned on project status and requirements.
Meeting Coordination: Schedule and coordinate brand team meetings, prepare agendas, document meeting minutes, and track follow-up items.
Project Controls: Assist Project Managers and Construction Managers with budget tracking, cost coding, and project schedule management.
Project Documentation: Prepare, manage, and distribute contracts, submittals, Requests for Information (RFIs), change orders, purchase orders, and other project-related documentation.
File Management: Organize and maintain complete, accurate, and current electronic project files across all brands.
Vendor Support: Assist the Vendor Manager with pipeline calls, schedule management, and material sample coordination.
Invoice Processing: Accurately process vendor invoices and monthly pay applications through the accounting software.
Agreement Management: Maintain an up-to-date file of NDAs and master contracts for vendors, architects, and General Contractors.
Project Closeout: Support the project closeout process by compiling warranties, as-built drawings, operations manuals, and other required closeout documentation.
Compliance Support: Assist with the preparation and coordination of annual Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD) updates.

What We Need

Education and Experience

Associate or bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred
Relevant experience in a construction project coordination or administrative role may be considered in place of a degree
One to three years of experience in a project coordination or administrative role within the construction industry
Basic ability to read and understand construction drawings

Skills And Qualifications

Proficiency in Smartsheet and Google Workspace
Proficiency with AVID accounting software
Familiarity with Gemini AI
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
Proactive, problem-solving mindset

Supervisory Responsibility

This position does not have any supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment

This role operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment, including computers, smartphones, video conferencing and webinar tools, phones, photocopiers, printers, filing cabinets, shredders, and fax machines.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to walk, talk, see, and hear. The Team Member must also be able to lift up to 20 pounds.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, salaried, non-exempt position requiring at least 40 hours per week. The regular schedule is Monday through Friday, between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Data Protection
new_jobs.description:
The Legal team is responsible for managing the legal affairs of the company, including providing legal counsel across the organization, handling disputes, and creating and enforcing intellectual property.

Position Summary

The Privacy COE is seeking a Program Coordinator, Data Protection to execute high-priority privacy and healthcare compliance workstreams, with emphasis on cybersecurity/privacy breach response and HIPAA program implementation for newly acquired entities.

This delivery-oriented role serves as project manager, coordinator, and execution lead. It is not an advisory legal role; legal and regulatory interpretation questions will be escalated while this position owns workflow execution, tracking, documentation, and follow-through.

Location and Work Hours

This position will be based in the United States because the work and contacts for daily work will be concentrated primarily in the United States, including U.S. cybersecurity breach response and HIPAA program activities, and will mainly support the Head of Privacy, who is located in the East Coast of the United States. Candidates outside the United States will be considered if they can maintain permanent U.S.-based working hours.

Role Objective

Increase capacity and throughput in Resmed’s highest-risk privacy workstreams by managing timelines, dependencies, documentation, and stakeholder coordination, enabling senior privacy leadership to focus on activities with high business value, direct support of important stakeholders, strategic advisory work and complex legal support.

Key Responsibilities

Privacy and Cybersecurity Incident Response

Manage operational workflows for cybersecurity and privacy incidents involving personal information, protected health information, or other regulated data.
Coordinate intake, triage support, evidence collection, stakeholder follow-up, remediation tracking, status reporting, and closure documentation.
Maintain incident trackers, timelines, decision logs, playbooks, templates, checklists, and escalation paths.
Identify delays, missing inputs, bottlenecks, and process gaps that may affect incident response timelines or documentation quality.
Support after event lessons learned and areas of improvement.

HIPAA Program Implementation for Acquisitions

Support HIPAA program buildout for newly acquired entities, including rollout of policies, procedures, templates, training, and related documentation.
Track milestones, dependencies, owners, risks, open items, completion evidence, and readiness activities for audits, assessments, training, and governance.
Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Security, IT, HR, and business stakeholders to complete onboarding and integration activities.

Project Management and Privacy Operations

Create and maintain project plans, action trackers, dashboards, issue logs, SOPs, and repeatable workflows for assigned privacy initiatives.
Drive workstream meetings, prepare agendas, document decisions and action items, and follow up to closure.
Support reporting on operational metrics, completion rates, aging items, risks, and status summaries.
Recommend process improvements to reduce cycle time, improve handoffs, eliminate duplication, and strengthen documentation.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
Organization, documentation, communication, stakeholder coordination, and follow-through skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities with urgency, accuracy, discretion, and sound judgment.
Proficiency with collaboration, reporting, and productivity tools.
Strong intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and willingness to quickly build fluency in privacy, cybersecurity, HIPAA, and compliance concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

High proficiency using AI tools to improve productivity, automate repeatable workflows, summarize and organize complex information, generate first drafts of project documentation, and identify opportunities to accelerate privacy operations while maintaining appropriate confidentiality, accuracy, and human oversight.

Success Profile

Highly organized, structured, execution-focused, and able to create order from ambiguity.
Persistent and diplomatic in follow-up, with strong ownership and attention to detail.
Comfortable working cross-functionally on sensitive matters involving legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, and reputational risk.
Uses good judgment to act independently where appropriate and escalate when legal interpretation, risk acceptance, or senior leadership decision-making is required.

Measures of Success

Incident response and HIPAA integration workstreams are tracked accurately, completed on time, and supported by clear documentation.
Privacy leadership has reliable dashboards and visibility into high-priority workstreams, bottlenecks, owners, and deadlines.
Repeatable workflows, templates, and playbooks improve speed, consistency, documentation quality, and operational throughput.

At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
401(k) with company match
Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career

Job Description

We are looking for a talented individual…

To join our team! CLEAResult's Strategic Energy Management (SEM) team is expanding, and we have a new opportunity for a Data Analyst to help power the work of our SEM experts across the US and Canada. If you love digging into data, spotting patterns others miss, and building the tools and templates that make a whole program run smoother, this is a great place to make an impact.

As a Data Analyst, you'll be the engine behind the scenes for our Statistical Analysts and SEM program teams across North America, supporting energy modeling, standardizing processes, and keeping our data clean, consistent, and ready to drive real decisions. This role is primarily internally facing and centered on data analysis, with occasional interaction with clients and end-use customers to gather data or answer questions. You'll play a central role in bringing consistency and efficiency to how our SEM teams work internationally, directly supporting the accuracy and quality of the models and reports our program depends on.

Here at CLEAResult, you will fit right in with our energetic team if you are resourceful, resilient, and kind.

In this role, you will…

Perform pre- and post-modeling data review and manipulation to support our Statistical Analysts.
Manipulate and format production data with precision and consistency.
Analyze large data sets to catch errors and ensure accuracy before it moves downstream.
Integrate data into statistical software templates.
Collaborate with internal and external teams to build and maintain database files.
Partner with program teams across the organization to create and maintain standardized templates for energy modeling and program data.
Write clear work instructions for newly developed templates, so others can pick them up with ease.
Track, draft, edit, and quality-control final models and reports.
Help automate data processing to save time and reduce manual error.
Troubleshoot, modify, and build tools using Visual Basic and Excel formulas.
Manage and manipulate data in Smartsheet.
Support benchmarking reporting and contribute to the development of our digital infrastructure.

For this exciting career opportunity, you're a great fit if you have…

Strong data manipulation and formatting skills, with an eye for consistency and detail
Experience analyzing large, complex data sets
Comfort working with statistical software and templates
Proficiency in Visual Basic and advanced Excel formulas
Experience with Smartsheet
SharePoint experience
A collaborative mindset, comfortable working across internal teams and occasionally with external clients and customers
Energy industry experience preferred, but not required

Please note: sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.

new_jobs.description:
Lutheran Community Services NW is a non-profit organization dedicated to serving communities throughout Washington, Oregon, and Idaho with a wide range of services for individuals of all ages and backgrounds. All LCSNW team members will contribute to our mission of partnering with individuals, families and communities for health, justice and hope

WHAT WE WILL DO FOR YOU:

As an employer of choice, we’re deeply committed to supporting our employees, because when you’re empowered, our mission thrives. We provide resources, tools, and care that allow you to focus on what matters most: delivering Health, Justice, and Hope
to the communities we serve. We’re proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and peace of mind

A 37.5 per hour work week to ensure work/life balance
Medical, dental, vision, and prescription benefits to keep you and your loved ones healthy
Employer-paid short- and long-term disability insurance
Life insurance coverage at no cost to you
Up to 2 weeks of vacation in your first year (based on hours worked)
Up to 2 weeks of sick leave (based on hours worked)
12 paid agency recognized holidays
2 floating holidays to use your way
403(b) retirement plan with employer matching (eligibility applies)
Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Potential eligibility for Student Loan Forgiveness through our 501(c)(3) nonprofit status

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

All LCSNW team members will contribute to our mission of partnering with individuals, families and communities for health, justice and hope. The Program Coordinator position is responsible for program coordination within the Community Integration and Resettlement Departments and serves as a key liaison between program staff, finance staff, and community partners by ensuring accurate documentation, timely financial transactions, data quality, and supporting successful program implementation through the coordination and administration of client assistance, and quality assurance.

Adhere to all program and affiliate organization record-keeping requirement and maintain accurate client records, databases, program documentation
Process client assistance payments, invoices, and program expenses in partnership with finance staff
Provide administrative and operational support to program staff and leadership including assistance supporting grant reporting, audits, and program monitoring activities.
Track program outcomes, client services, performance data and help identify opportunities to improve program processes and service delivery
Ensure client folders are complete, organized, and in compliance with grant requirements

HOW YOU WILL BE A GREAT FIT:

2 years of office/administrative experience, with data entry experience.
High school diploma or equivalent.
Reliable transportation for business purposes, such as between work locations and community settings as this position drives clients in personal and/or agency rental.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to read, write, and speak in English.
Standard LCSNW criminal clearance, including national sex offender, motor vehicle records, valid Oregon driver’s license with clean driving record, and active auto insurance.

Thank you!
We sincerely appreciate your interest in joining the Lutheran Community Services NW team and thank all applicants for taking the time to apply. While we’re unable to respond to every candidate individually, please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Lutheran Community Services NW is deeply committed to our mission of Health, Justice and Hope in all aspects of our work. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to help us build a stronger, more compassionate community.
